textTemplates.text:
This notification is to inform you that the Partner on the Primary Quote for the Opportunity linked below has been changed. The Primary Quote now reflects the newly assigned Partner.

You are receiving this notification because you are listed as the Contract Owner on this Opportunity. Please ensure that any related agreement documents are aligned with this Partner change.

Opportunity Link: {!formula_OppLink}

Close Date: {!$Record.SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.CloseDate}

Primary Quote: {!formula_QuoteLink}

Thank You,

Contract Operations
